description: Yasutoshi Moteki at Nanzan University publishes tools for constructing and checking community-bus GTFS geometry around Agui and the Chita Peninsula, Japan. The August 2026 release provides R scripts, a corrected version-5.0 Agui feed, route and per-minute trajectory tables, and GPS logging examples. Files are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. This record also covers predecessor 20575685, which contains broader static-GTFS conversion and playback tools but a known Agui geometry defect. The successor documents corrected shapes, terminal stops and duplicate trajectory rows. These resources can prepare route geometry and timetables for transport simulations. GPS examples have masked calendar dates; their reported accuracy is not independent validation. The README still describes an older version, so users must reconcile it with current release notes. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the family. No scripts or feeds were downloaded or run.
